meta.name: hyperframes-registry
meta.description: Install, discover, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 安装并接线 HyperFrames 的界面构建块
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在用 HyperFrames 搭建应用
copy.tagline_en: Install and wire HyperFrames building blocks into your UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building apps with HyperFrames

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把你的需求转成 hyperframes 命令行操作:搜索注册表、安装块或组件到项目、告诉你接线方式,并在搜索结果不匹配时报告缺口。它也能按模板引导你创作新块/组件并准备提交。
howto.when: 当你说要运行 hyperframes add/catalog、安装某个块或组件、把已装的项接进 index.html 等 HyperFrames 操作时触发。

say.text: 用 hyperframes add 安装 data-chart 块。
say.note: CLI 会写入文件并提示接线信息。

say.text: 搜索能逐行显示标题的组件。
say.note: 会运行 catalog --query 按相关度排名。

say.text: 把已安装的 grain-overlay 组件接进我的 index.html。
say.note: 会给出需复制的 HTML/CSS/JS 片段。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude can run hyperframes CLI to search the registry, install blocks/components, explain wiring, and report gaps when nothing matches. It also helps author new items via templates.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to run hyperframes add/catalog, install a specific block or component, or wire an installed item into index.html.

say_en.text: Install the data-chart block with hyperframes add.
say_en.note: It writes files and prints wiring info.

say_en.text: Search for a component that reveals a headline line by line.
say_en.note: It runs catalog --query and ranks results.

say_en.text: Wire the grain-overlay component into my index.html.
say_en.note: It gives HTML/CSS/JS snippets to copy.
